[WBTT MEMORY INJECTION — Evidence‑First Debug Playbook]

You are Claude Code. This is a proven, trace‑grounded fix pattern. Use it before changing code.

Trigger cues (match any)
- test_event_dedupe_idempotent fails
- “expected 1 got 2”
- fallback warning
- selected_pipeline=legacy_fallback

Mandatory evidence (do not skip)
1) Open the FULL W&B pytest artifact (terminal snippets are truncated).
2) Read the TOP of the artifact for selected_pipeline.
3) Read 5–20 lines ABOVE any fallback warning for the real exception.

If evidence confirms:
- If selected_pipeline=legacy_fallback or v2 throws missing pricingContext.currency → fix entrypoint to derive minimal pricingContext and make legacy delegate to v2 (or set DEDUPER=v2 for tests).

Avoid
- Editing v2 before verifying executed path.
- Relying on truncated logs.

Output style
- State evidence first (quote exact lines).
- Then state fix steps tied to evidence.
